title: Budget profile
description: Derived from design/RUN_RECORDS.md 1.1; the document wins. Draft. One budget profile file (section 4.1): a versioned configuration file that names every limit an attempt runs under, the development profile or the evaluation profile. Every value is written out; disabled is a written value, never an omission; zero means not allowed; every value not set from the measurements of section 4.8 carries 'not calibrated' (section 4.1, rules 1, 2 and 5).
$comment: Derived from design/RUN_RECORDS.md 1.1; the document wins. Section 4.1 names its items in a table but gives few key names (token_caps, max_tokens, max_iterations), and section 2.4 gives the names of the limits (request_limit, wall_clock_minutes, input_cap); the others are proposed. The values are not set here: the development values are those of D19 A (section 4.6), and the evaluation values come from the measurements and the ledger Decision of section 4.9, whose formula is not restated here. The container limits of D20 A are not part of a budget profile: they belong to the isolation profile that the runtime manifest binds (section 4.1, row Container limits), so the file has no field for them. Not expressed here: that an evaluation cap stays within the route's documented maximum and context length (section 4.9); that the file's checksum is recorded in the run log (section 2.9). The examples are illustrative: ids, times, checksums, sizes, counts, model and route names and the max_tokens value are made up and are not proposed values.

name.description: Proposed name and values: which profile.

version.description: Proposed name. The profile's version; a change is a new version (section 4.1, rule 3).

label.description: Proposed name. The label (section 4.1, row Label).

decision.description: Proposed name. Evaluation profile only: the ledger Decision that froze it (section 4.9).

token_caps.description: disabled under the development profile, written out; enabled under the evaluation profile (section 4.1).

agents.description: Proposed name. The limits per agent; under the evaluation profile the caps are set per agent (section 4.9).

hermes_retries.description: Proposed name. Hermes's own retries at their lowest where Hermes allows it (D12 A; section 4.6).

capability_zeros.description: Proposed name. The capability zeros, containment rules, not budgets: delegation, child agents, recursion, fallback requests, helper requests, mixture-of-agents calls, tools for any agent, and model requests by deterministic software (section 4.5).

technical_reruns_per_step.description: Proposed name. At most one technical re-run per agent step (D14 A).

rounds.description: Proposed name. Rounds: counted, not capped (development); evaluation stops after round 1 (section 4.1).

max_tokens.description: max_tokens on every request: under the development profile the route's documented maximum output, taken from the route record and passed explicitly; under the evaluation profile the agent's frozen output cap (section 4.1).

input_cap.description: Input tokens: not limited under the development profile (measured); the agent's frozen input cap under the evaluation profile (sections 4.1 and 4.10).

request_limit.description: Requests per attempt: the request guard (development) or the frozen request cap (evaluation).

wall_clock_minutes.description: Wall-clock time per attempt, in minutes: the guard (development) or the frozen cap (evaluation).

stage_attempt_limit.description: Proposed name. Agent attempts per pipeline stage of one round: the guard (development) or the frozen cap (evaluation).

limit_value.description: A limit value with its calibration label.

calibration.description: Proposed name. not calibrated, or set from measurements (section 4.1, rule 5).
